scenes.title: Lunch at a family restaurant
scenes.setting: Lunchtime at a small family-run home-style restaurant in Beijing, where the server seats the traveler, takes the order and settles the bill.

local.l1: Welcome! How many?
Hello, how many of you?
Hi there! How many?
Oh, hello! How many for lunch?
May I ask how many?

replies.roman: Jiù wǒ yí gè, zuò nǎr?
replies.back: Just me. Where should I sit?

others.roman: Yí gè rén, yǒu wèizi ma?
others.back: One. Do you have a seat?

moments.intent: seats the guest, gives the menu

local.l1: This way, please. Here's the menu.
Have a seat here. Here's the menu.
Sit anywhere. The menu's on the table.

local.text: 坐靠窗那儿吧，菜单您先看看。
local.l1: Take the spot by the window and have a look at the menu.
Come, sit over here. Here's a menu for you.

replies.back: A bowl of zhajiang noodles, please.

others.roman: Lái yí fèn xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn.

moments.intent: asks if the guest eats spicy food

local.l1: Can you eat spicy food?
Does spicy food bother you?
Anything you don't eat? Is spicy OK?
Let me ask first: do you eat spicy food?
Can you eat chili peppers?

others.roman: Bú yào là, yě bú yào xiāngcài.

local.text: 那您尝尝京酱肉丝，我们家招牌。
local.l1: Then try the shredded pork in sweet bean sauce, our signature.

local.text: 我推荐京酱肉丝，卷豆皮吃，特香。
local.l1: I'd go for the jingjiang pork. Wrap it in tofu skin, so good.

local.text: 我们家京酱肉丝卖得最好，您试试？
local.l1: Our jingjiang pork sells best. Want to try it?

local.text: 京酱肉丝吧，北京特色，甜口儿的。
local.l1: Get the jingjiang pork: a Beijing specialty, a bit sweet.

local.text: 嗯，京酱肉丝不错，客人都爱点。
local.l1: Hmm, the jingjiang pork is good. Everyone orders it.

replies.back: I'd like the moo shu pork.

others.roman: Hǎo, zài lái yì wǎn mǐfàn.
others.back: OK, and a bowl of rice.
I'd like to try the zhajiang noodles.

moments.intent: asks if they want anything else

local.l1: Got it. Anything else?
Would you like to add a dish?
OK, noted. Anything else to order?

local.text: 还要别的菜不？凉菜什么的？
local.l1: Any other dishes? A cold dish, maybe?
Want anything else?

moments.intent: asks what they'd like to drink

local.l1: What would you like to drink?
What'll you have to drink?
Would you like something to drink?
And to drink? We have soft drinks and beer.

local.text: 喝点儿啥？冰的常温的都有。
local.l1: What to drink? We have it cold or room temperature.

others.back: Just a cup of hot water.

local.text: 吃得怎么样？还合口味吗？
local.l1: How was everything? Was it to your taste?
How did it taste?
What did you think?
Did it taste all right?
I hope it was to your liking?

replies.back: I'm full. How much is it?

local.l1: That's sixty-eight yuan altogether.

local.text: 我算一下啊，一共六十八。
local.l1: Let me add it up... sixty-eight in total.
Your table comes to sixty-eight.
OK, all added up: sixty-eight.
Sure, sixty-eight yuan.

moments.intent: points to the QR code to scan

local.l1: Sure, just scan this code.
Just scan the code.
Sure, the QR code is on the wall.

local.text: 没问题，扫这个码，微信支付宝都行。
local.l1: No problem. Scan this code; WeChat or Alipay both work.
Scan my code here.

replies.roman: Fù hǎo le, nín kàn yíxià.

local.l1: Got it, thank you! Take care!
It came through. Take care!
Payment received, thanks!
All set, got it. See you!
Got it, got it. Take care on your way!

replies.roman: Wǒ hái huì zài lái de!

scenes.title: Haggling at the Market
scenes.setting: At a busy tourist street market in Beijing, a friendly, slightly pushy stall vendor selling silk scarves, T-shirts and souvenirs haggles with the traveler over a silk scarf.

local.text: 想买点儿什么？过来瞧瞧！
local.l1: What would you like? Come take a look!
Hello, what are you looking for?

local.text: 来来来，丝巾、短袖、纪念品，都有！
local.l1: Come on over: silk scarves, T-shirts, souvenirs, I have it all!

local.text: 过来看看吧，不买也没关系！
local.l1: Come have a look, it's fine if you don't buy!

local.text: 找什么呢？我这儿啥都有。
local.l1: Looking for something? I've got everything here.

others.back: I'd like to look at the silk scarves.
How much are the silk scarves?

local.l1: Look at this scarf, it's real silk!
How about this one? It feels really nice.
Feel this fabric, so smooth!

local.text: 这丝巾卖得最好，好多人都买。
local.l1: This scarf is my best seller; lots of people buy it.
This one makes a really impressive gift!
This one is a hundred and fifty yuan.
A hundred fifty each, a good deal.
This one? A hundred fifty.
You've got a good eye! A hundred fifty.
A hundred fifty, totally worth it!

replies.roman: Tài guì le, piányi diǎnr ba.

others.back: Can you go a bit lower?

others.roman: Tài guì le, bú yào le.

local.text: 那给您便宜点儿，一百二吧。
local.l1: Then I'll knock it down for you: a hundred twenty.
I'll give you twenty percent off: a hundred twenty.
A hundred twenty, call it a friendship price.

local.text: 哎呀，一百二，够意思了吧？
local.l1: Oh, come on, a hundred twenty. That's generous of me, right?
Thirty off for you: a hundred twenty.

others.roman: Suàn le, wǒ bú yào le.

local.l1: A hundred is my lowest, I can't go any lower.
A hundred yuan, that's my bottom price.

local.text: 真不行，一百，我都没赚头了。
local.l1: I really can't. A hundred, and I'm barely making anything.

local.text: 您给一百吧，再少真不卖了。
local.l1: Give me a hundred. Any less and I won't sell.
A hundred, not a cent less.

replies.roman: Hǎo ba, nà jiù mǎi le.

replies.back: Then I'll look around some more.

others.roman: Bāshí, bù xíng jiù suàn le.

moments.intent: calls the traveler back, gives in

local.l1: Hey, don't go! Eighty, take it!
Come back, come back! Eighty, it's yours!
Fine, eighty. I give in!
Hang on! Eighty, it's yours.

local.text: 行行行，八十，真服了您了！
local.l1: OK, OK, eighty. You drive a hard bargain!
You got it! Pick any color you like.
Which color? I'll find it for you.
Pick a color, there are lots.

local.text: 颜色多着呢，您喜欢哪个？
local.l1: There are plenty of colors. Which do you like?
There's purple and green too, have a pick.

others.roman: Yì tiáo hóng de, yì tiáo lán de.

moments.intent: asks how the traveler will pay

local.l1: Scan the code, or cash?

local.text: 您怎么付？扫码还是给现金？
local.l1: How are you paying? Scan or cash?
Paying cash, or scanning?
Cash, or pay by phone?

local.text: 钱怎么给？扫码还是现金？
local.l1: How do you want to pay? Scan or cash?
The code's right here, go ahead and scan it.
Sure, just scan this code.
Sure, just scan right here.

local.text: 二维码贴这儿呢，您扫吧。
local.l1: The QR code is stuck right here, go ahead.

local.text: 微信支付宝都能扫，码在这儿。
local.l1: WeChat or Alipay, both work. The code's right here.

local.text: 收到了！袋子给您，慢走啊！
local.l1: Got it! Here's your bag, take care!

local.text: 到账了！给您装好了，慢走！
local.l1: It came through! All bagged up, take care!

local.text: 收到啦，给您套个袋儿，下回再来！
local.l1: Got it, I'll pop it in a bag. Come again!

local.text: 钱收到了，您拿好，慢走啊！
local.l1: Payment received. Hold on to it, take care!

local.text: 东西给您装好了，玩儿得开心！
local.l1: All bagged up for you. Have fun!

others.roman: Wǒ hái huì zài lái de!

scenes.title: DiDi ride to Qianmen
scenes.setting: An American visitor on a week's vacation takes a DiDi across Beijing to a hotel near Qianmen and chats with the driver on the way.

moments.intent: confirms the rider by phone tail number

local.text: 您好，手机尾号三八二七是吧？
local.l1: Hi, your phone number ends in 3827, right?

local.text: 是尾号三八二七的乘客吗？
local.l1: Are you the passenger ending in 3827?
Ending in 3827?

local.text: 哎，您好！是尾号三八二七吗？
local.l1: Hey, hi! Is it the one ending in 3827?

local.text: 那个，您手机尾号是三八二七吧？
local.l1: Um, your phone ends in 3827, right?

others.roman: Shì de, wǒ shì sān bā èr qī.

local.text: 去前门附近的酒店是吧？
local.l1: Going to the hotel near Qianmen, right?

local.text: 您是到前门附近的酒店吧？
local.l1: You're headed to the hotel near Qianmen?

local.text: 目的地是前门附近的酒店，对吧？
local.l1: Your destination is the hotel near Qianmen, right?

local.text: 我确认一下，去前门附近的酒店？
local.l1: Let me check: the hotel near Qianmen?

local.text: 咱们去前门附近的酒店，没错吧？
local.l1: We're going to the hotel near Qianmen, correct?

local.text: 嗯，前门附近的酒店，对吗？
local.l1: Mm, the hotel near Qianmen, right?

others.back: Yes. How long will it take?

moments.intent: asks to buckle up and sets off

local.text: 麻烦系一下安全带，咱们出发了啊。
local.l1: Please fasten your seatbelt, we're setting off.
Buckle up, here we go.

local.text: 您把安全带系上，我这就开车。
local.l1: Put your seatbelt on and I'll get going.

local.text: 安全带系一下，咱们准备出发了。
local.l1: Seatbelt on, please, we're about to leave.

local.text: 好嘞，安全带系上，开车了啊。
local.l1: Alright, seatbelt on, I'm pulling out.

replies.back: OK. About how long will it take?

others.back: Is there traffic on the way?

moments.intent: warns of traffic and gives the travel time

local.text: 这会儿有点堵，得四十分钟左右。
local.l1: It's a bit jammed right now, about forty minutes.

local.text: 路上有点堵车，大概四十来分钟。
local.l1: There's some traffic, roughly forty minutes.

local.text: 这个点儿正赶上高峰，得四十分钟。
local.l1: It's rush hour right now, so forty minutes.

local.text: 前面堵着呢，差不多四十分钟能到。
local.l1: It's backed up ahead; we'll get there in about forty minutes.

local.text: 导航说四十分钟，今天车有点多。
local.l1: The navigation says forty minutes; lots of cars today.

replies.back: No problem, I'm not in a hurry.
Good, a chance to see Beijing.

moments.intent: asks if it's the first visit to Beijing or China

local.l1: Is this your first time in Beijing?
First time in Beijing?

local.text: 哎，您这是头一回来北京吧？
local.l1: Hey, this is your first trip to Beijing, huh?

local.text: 是来北京旅游的吧？第一次来？
local.l1: Visiting Beijing as a tourist? First time?
First time in China, right?

replies.roman: Shì de, lái wán yí gè xīngqī.
replies.back: Yes, I'm on vacation for a week.

others.roman: Duì, dì yī cì lái Zhōngguó.
others.back: Yes, my first time in China.

others.roman: Duì, wǒ shì cóng Měiguó lái de.

local.text: 一会儿给您停路边还是门口？
local.l1: Shall I stop at the curb or at the entrance?

local.text: 停路边行吗，还是要停门口？
local.l1: Is the curb OK, or do you want the entrance?

local.text: 您是路边下，还是门口下？
local.l1: Getting out at the curb or at the door?

local.text: 停哪儿合适？路边还是门口？
local.l1: Where should I stop? The curb or the entrance?

local.text: 那个，停门口还是路边啊？
local.l1: Um, the entrance or the curb?

others.back: Stopping at the curb is fine.

local.l1: Here we are, this is it.
Alright, we've arrived.

local.text: 到了啊，开门注意后面的车。
local.l1: We're here. Watch for cars behind when you open the door.

local.text: 到了到了，东西别落下啊。
local.l1: Here we are, don't leave anything behind.
OK, we're here.

others.back: Thanks, that was a smooth ride!
Excuse me, how do I get to the subway?

moments.intent: explains the fare is paid in the app, not cash

local.text: 不用给现金，手机上付就行。
local.l1: No cash needed, just pay on your phone.

local.text: 车费在软件上付，不收现金。
local.l1: The fare is paid in the app; I don't take cash.

local.text: 钱不用给我，平台自动扣。
local.l1: Don't pay me; the platform charges you automatically.

local.text: 那个，车费网上付就可以。
local.l1: Um, you can just pay the fare online.

local.text: 打车软件上直接付，不用现金啊。
local.l1: You pay right in the ride app; no cash needed.

replies.back: OK. How do I get to the subway?

others.back: Is there a subway station nearby?
How do I take the subway?

moments.intent: gives a short direction to the subway

local.text: 往前走，过个路口就是地铁站。
local.l1: Go straight; the subway station is just past the intersection.

local.text: 往前走五分钟，就能看见地铁站。
local.l1: Walk straight ahead for five minutes and you'll see the station.

local.text: 地铁站挺近的，往那边走几分钟就到。
local.l1: The station is pretty close, just a few minutes' walk that way.

local.text: 坐地铁啊？顺着这条路一直走就到。
local.l1: Taking the subway? Follow this road straight and you're there.

local.text: 您往那边走，看见地铁口就是了。
local.l1: Head that way until you see the subway entrance.

others.roman: Tài hǎo le, hěn jìn a!

local.text: 好嘞，慢走啊，玩儿得开心！
local.l1: Alright, take care, have fun!
Take care, have a nice trip!
OK, take care, goodbye!
OK, bye-bye, have a good time!
Right then, take care!

scenes.title: Café chat with a local
scenes.setting: On a quiet afternoon in a Beijing café, a friendly local at the next table notices the traveler is a visitor and starts a chat.
scenes.localRole: A friendly Beijing local at the next table

moments.intent: asks where the traveler is from

local.l1: Hi! Which country are you from?
Where are you from?

local.text: 你是外国人吧？从哪儿来的？
local.l1: You're from abroad, right? Where from?

local.text: 您好，请问您是哪个国家的？
local.l1: Hello, may I ask what country you're from?

local.text: 哎，看你不像本地人，哪国来的呀？
local.l1: Hey, you don't look local. Where are you from?

replies.back: The US. I've never been to China before.

others.roman: Wǒ shì cóng Měiguó lái de.

others.back: American. I've never been here before.

moments.intent: asks if it is their first visit

local.l1: Is this your first time in China?
First time in Beijing, right?
Your first trip to Beijing?

local.text: 这是你第一次来中国吗？
local.l1: Is this your first visit to China?
This is your first time in China, I take it?

replies.roman: Shì a, lái wán yí gè xīngqī.
replies.back: Yes, I'm here for a week of fun.

moments.intent: asks how long they are staying

local.l1: How long are you planning to stay in Beijing?
How many days are you here for?
How long will you be here?
How long are you staying?
How long can you stay this trip?

replies.roman: Jiù qī tiān, lái dùjià de.
replies.back: Just seven days. I'm on vacation.

local.text: 来北京是旅游还是出差？
local.l1: Are you in Beijing to sightsee or for work?

local.text: 这次是来玩儿还是来办事儿？
local.l1: Is this trip for fun or for work?
Here on business, or for fun?

local.text: 你是来工作的，还是来玩儿的？
local.l1: Are you here to work or to have fun?
What made you decide to come to Beijing?

replies.roman: Lái wán, yě xiǎng chángchang měishí.
replies.back: For fun, and to try the food.

local.l1: What do you think of Beijing?
Beijing's pretty nice, isn't it?
Do you like Beijing?
What's your impression of Beijing?
How does Beijing feel to you?

replies.roman: Hěn xǐhuan! Yǒu shénme hǎowán de?
replies.back: I love it! What's good to see?

replies.text: 挺好的，我想尝尝北京菜。
replies.roman: Tǐng hǎo de, wǒ xiǎng chángchang Běijīng cài.
replies.back: It's great. I want to try Beijing food.

others.back: Is there anything good to eat?

local.text: 故宫肯定得去，长城的话去慕田峪，人少。
local.l1: The Forbidden City is a must. For the Great Wall, go to Mutianyu: fewer people.

local.text: 要我说啊，先逛故宫，再去慕田峪爬长城。
local.l1: If you ask me, see the Forbidden City first, then climb the Great Wall at Mutianyu.

local.text: 故宫和长城都值得去，长城推荐慕田峪那段。
local.l1: The Forbidden City and the Great Wall are both worth it; for the Wall, try the Mutianyu section.

local.text: 去故宫转转，长城别去八达岭，去慕田峪，人少。
local.l1: Look around the Forbidden City. For the Great Wall, skip Badaling and go to Mutianyu: fewer people.

local.text: 故宫值得一看，有空再去慕田峪爬爬长城。
local.l1: The Forbidden City is worth a look; if you have time, climb the Great Wall at Mutianyu.

replies.back: Great, I'll be sure to go!
How do I get to the Forbidden City?

others.back: I'm definitely going to the Great Wall!

local.text: 坐地铁一号线，天安门东站下车。
local.l1: Take subway Line 1 and get off at Tiananmen East.

local.text: 地铁最方便，一号线，天安门东站下。
local.l1: The subway's easiest: Line 1, get off at Tiananmen East.

local.text: 打车也行，不过坐一号线到天安门东更方便。
local.l1: A taxi works too, but Line 1 to Tiananmen East is easier.

local.text: 坐一号线到天安门东，走过去就到了。
local.l1: Take Line 1 to Tiananmen East and walk over from there.

local.text: 不远，坐一号线到天安门东就行。
local.l1: It's not far: take Line 1 to Tiananmen East.

replies.back: I think I'll take a taxi.

local.text: 吃的话，一定得尝尝烤鸭和炸酱面，都不辣。
local.l1: For food, you've got to try roast duck and zhajiang noodles. Neither is spicy.

local.text: 烤鸭你得吃，老北京炸酱面也特地道，都不辣。
local.l1: You have to have roast duck, and old Beijing zhajiang noodles are the real thing. Neither is spicy.

local.text: 烤鸭、炸酱面都得尝尝，都不辣，你肯定爱吃。
local.l1: Try roast duck and zhajiang noodles. Neither is spicy; you'll love them.

local.text: 好吃的可多了，烤鸭、炸酱面可别错过，都不辣。
local.l1: There's so much good food. Don't miss roast duck and zhajiang noodles. Neither is spicy.

local.text: 烤鸭得吃，再来碗炸酱面，一点儿都不辣。
local.l1: Have roast duck, then a bowl of zhajiang noodles. Not spicy at all.

replies.roman: Nà zhènghǎo, wǒ bú tài néng chī là.
replies.back: Good, since I can't eat very spicy food.

others.roman: Kǎoyā wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎng chī le!
others.back: I've wanted to try roast duck for ages!

moments.intent: suggests adding each other on WeChat

local.text: 咱们加个微信吧？有事儿随时找我。
local.l1: Shall we add each other on WeChat? Message me anytime.

local.text: 加个微信吧，有啥不懂的就问我。
local.l1: Let's add each other on WeChat; ask me if anything's unclear.

local.text: 要不加个微信？在北京有事儿可以找我。
local.l1: Why don't we add each other on WeChat? If you need anything in Beijing, just ask.
Mind if we add each other on WeChat?

local.text: 你有微信吧？咱俩加一下。
local.l1: You have WeChat, right? Let's add each other.

replies.roman: Hǎo a, wǒ sǎo nǐ ba.

others.roman: Kěyǐ, zhè shì wǒ de èrwéimǎ.

local.text: 那我先走了，祝你玩儿得开心！
local.l1: Well, I'll get going. Have a great time!

local.text: 我得走了，在北京玩儿好啊！
local.l1: I have to go. Enjoy Beijing!

local.text: 时间不早了，我先撤了，拜拜！
local.l1: It's getting late, I'm off. Bye!

local.text: 好嘞，我该走了，玩儿得愉快！
local.l1: Alright, I should get going. Enjoy your trip!

local.text: 那我先回去了，你慢慢喝啊！
local.l1: I'll head back now. Enjoy your drink!

replies.back: It was nice to meet you!

scenes.title: Ordering at a café
scenes.setting: A busy coffee shop in Beijing's Sanlitun, where the barista takes the order at the counter, asks about size, temperature, milk and sugar, takes payment and calls the pickup number.

local.l1: Hello, what would you like to drink?

local.text: 欢迎光临！今天喝点儿什么？
local.l1: Welcome! What are you having today?
Hi, what can I get you?
Hi there! What would you like?
Hello, I can take your order now.

others.roman: Wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi kāfēi.

others.back: Let me look at the menu first.

local.text: 我们家招牌是生椰拿铁，要不要试试？
local.l1: Our signature is the coconut latte. Want to try it?

local.text: 推荐您试试生椰拿铁，卖得最好。
local.l1: I'd recommend the coconut latte, it's our best seller.

local.text: 生椰拿铁挺受欢迎的，您可以尝尝。
local.l1: The coconut latte is really popular, you could try it.

local.text: 第一次来的话，可以试试我们的生椰拿铁。
local.l1: If it's your first time, try our coconut latte.

local.text: 今天推荐生椰拿铁，不太甜。
local.l1: Today I'd recommend the coconut latte, it's not too sweet.

others.roman: Nà jiù lái yì bēi ba.
Wǒ yào yì bēi měishì jiù hǎo.

local.l1: Large or medium?
What size would you like?
Large, medium or small?
How big a cup?
Medium? Or large?
Hot or iced?
Iced or hot?
Should the drink be hot or iced?
Hot or iced to drink?

local.text: 冰的还是热的？最近冰的卖得多。
local.l1: Iced or hot? Iced sells more these days.

moments.intent: offers to switch to oat milk

local.l1: Would you like to switch to oat milk?
You can switch to oat milk. Want to?

local.text: 牛奶用普通的还是燕麦的？
local.l1: Regular milk or oat milk?
Oat milk is three yuan extra. Want it?

local.text: 奶要换吗？我们有燕麦奶。
local.l1: Change the milk? We have oat milk.
Do you want sugar?

local.text: 甜度呢？正常糖还是少糖？
local.l1: And sweetness? Normal or less sugar?
Would you like syrup?
Normal sugar or half?
How sweet would you like it?

replies.roman: Wǒ yào bù jiā táng de.

moments.intent: asks for here or to go

local.l1: For here or to go?
Dine in or take away?
Are you drinking it in the shop?
Are you taking it to go?
Drinking here or taking out?

moments.intent: tells the total, asks how to pay

local.text: 一共三十二，扫码还是刷卡？
local.l1: That's 32 in total. Scan or card?
32 yuan, just scan here.
32 yuan altogether. How will you pay?

local.text: 好的，三十二，微信支付宝都可以。
local.l1: OK, 32. WeChat or Alipay both work.
32 in total, please scan the code.

local.text: 您的取餐号是三十八号，请稍等。
local.l1: Your pickup number is 38, please wait a moment.

local.text: 这是您的小票，上面是取餐号。
local.l1: Here's your receipt, the pickup number is on it.
Please wait, about five minutes.

local.text: 付款成功。您拿着小票，在那边等一下。
local.l1: Payment went through. Keep your receipt and wait over there.

local.text: 收到了，取餐号三十八，稍等一会儿。
local.l1: Got it. Pickup number 38, wait a little.

replies.back: About how long is the wait?

local.text: 三十八号，您的拿铁好了！
local.l1: Number 38, your latte is ready!
Number 38, pickup!

local.text: 您的咖啡做好了，请慢用。
local.l1: Your coffee is ready, enjoy.
Your drink is ready, enjoy!

local.text: 三十八号，三十八号，来取一下咖啡！
local.l1: Number 38, number 38, come get your coffee!
